   - Maintaining the integral constraint and function bounds through the optimization
   - Monitoring convergence and budget to prevent costly runs

   This addresses the challenge of finding the optimal h by focusing on a local ext region while ensuring all solutions satisfy the constraints and evaluation criteria.
